xerampelinae.definition: xērampelinae ārum, f, chrampe/linai (like dry vine-leaves; sc. vestes), dark-red clothes, dark dresses, Iu.

xiphias.definition: xiphiās ae, m, cifi/as, a sword-fish: durus, O.

xystus.definition: xystus ī, m, custo/s, a covered colonnade for winter exercise; hence, an open colonnade, garden-terrace, shaded walk: inambulare in xysto, C., Ph.
